title: Identity and Access Management Engineer
summary: An identity and access management (IAM) engineer controls who can log in to which systems and what they can do there. They sit in the security or IT team and run tools for single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor login (MFA), privileged access and access reviews.
dailyDuties: Run directory, SSO, MFA and privileged access platforms such as Okta, Entra ID or CyberArk
Integrate applications using SAML, OIDC and SCIM
Configure provisioning, joiner-mover-leaver flows and access reviews in an IGA tool
Automate identity tasks with PowerShell or Python and platform APIs
Troubleshoot login, provisioning and access issues
Onboard application owners and document access processes

skills.expectation: Run directory, SSO, MFA and privileged access platforms such as Okta, Entra ID or CyberArk
Set up SAML, OIDC and SCIM integrations for applications
Configure provisioning, joiner-mover-leaver flows and access reviews in an IGA tool
Build connectors and automation against identity platform APIs
Troubleshoot login, provisioning and access issues
Onboard application owners and document access processes
Produce access evidence for audits and IT general controls
Know the access controls in ISO 27001, SOX or PCI DSS
Customise IGA rules and connectors written in Java
Administer Entra ID and Azure role assignments
Query identity data and application user tables
Manage certificates and signing keys used in federation

groups.label: A scripting language for identity automation (PowerShell or Python)

certifications.why: Microsoft identity administration, common in Entra ID shops
